description: This Java class 'Images' provides sample image URLs and thumbnail URLs for use in an example Android application focused on displaying bitmaps. It serves as a data provider with static URL arrays, crediting sources and hinting at dynamic fetching via API.

classes.name: Images
classes.description: A utility class containing static arrays of image and thumbnail URLs used for sample images in the application.
